name: Warhammer
description: Solid iron bludgeon capable of splintering shield and skull.

name: Dagger
description: Light and easily concealed blade; nimble enough to bypass enemy guard (+1 attack).

name: Sword
description: Well-balanced arming sword of grim steel (+1 attack).

name: Flail
description: Spiked iron ball on a heavy chain; crushing kinetic force (1d6+1 damage).

name: Mighty Zweihänder
description: Massive two-handed executioner's sword discovered in ancient crypts (1d6+2 damage).
